data: Which of the following lines have a value greater than 2 at a distance of 10?

Let me analyze this step by step:

1. The question asks about values greater than 2 at a distance of 10.
2. Looking at the graph, I need to focus on the line corresponding to "she > she" (the downward-pointing triangle).
3. At approximately 10 units on the x-axis (distance), the "she > she" line is clearly above 2.
4. The other lines (he > he, he > she, and she > he) all remain below 2 at this point.

Therefore, only one line has a value greater than 2 at a distance of 10.
